# Summary

This document generates and exports publication-ready high-resolution figures for the Ampudia Mediterranean mixed forest thinning trial data paper:

1. **Stand-level metrics summary** (Density, Basal Area, Dominant Height, and Volume across plots and inventories).
2. **Tree spatial distribution and status** (Color: Status, Shape: Species).
3. **Tree spatial distribution and species** (Color: Species, Shape: Status).
4. **Multi-scale geographical location map** (European context, Spanish context, and Stand plot distribution).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Core & Data Manipulation
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

# Visualization
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Spatial & Mapping
library(sf)
library(maps)

```

## 1. Stand Level Metrics by Plot and Inventory

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load dataset
plots_desc_path <- ifelse(file.exists("../plots_description.csv"), "../plots_description.csv", "final/plots_description.csv")
plots_desc <- read.csv(plots_desc_path)

# Create simplified plot ID / label (0, 15, 30, 45 % thinning)
plots_desc$plot_num <- factor(plots_desc$plot_id - 2434000, levels = 1:4, labels = c("control", "15", "30", "45"))

# Prepare long-format data for faceted plotting
plots_long <- plots_desc %>%
  select(inventory_id, plot_num, n, g, ho, sfni_vcc) %>%
  rename(
    `N (trees/ha)` = n,
    `G (m²/ha)` = g,
    `Ho (m)` = ho,
    `VCC (m³/ha)` = sfni_vcc
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`N (trees/ha)`, `G (m²/ha)`, `Ho (m)`, `VCC (m³/ha)`), 
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("N (trees/ha)", "G (m²/ha)", "Ho (m)", "VCC (m³/ha)")))

# Create joint graph
joint_plot <- ggplot(plots_long, aes(x = plot_num, y = value, fill = as.factor(inventory_id))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    # title = "Stand level metrics per plot and inventory",
    x = "Thinning intensity (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Inventory"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(joint_plot)

# Save high-resolution publication figure
ggsave(filename = "figure_1_stand_level_metrics.png", plot = joint_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)

# Clean memory
rm(plots_desc, plots_long, plots_desc_path)
```

## 2. Tree Spatial Distribution (Color: Status, Shape: Species)

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load tree inventory
trees_inv_path <- ifelse(file.exists("../trees_inventory.csv"), "../trees_inventory.csv", "final/trees_inventory.csv")
trees_inv <- read.csv(trees_inv_path)

# Prepare spatial data for all inventories using tree_status
trees_spatial_all <- trees_inv %>%
  filter(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_num = factor(plot_id - 2434000, levels = 1:4, labels = c("control", "15", "30", "45")),
    Status = case_when(
      tree_status == "I" ~ "Ingrowth",
      tree_status == "C" ~ "Harvested",
      tree_status == "M" ~ "Dead",
      TRUE ~ "Alive"
    ),
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Alive", "Ingrowth", "Harvested", "Dead"))
  )

# Reusable plot function (Version 1: Color = Status, Shape = Species)
create_inv_plot_v1 <- function(inv_id, title) {
  df <- trees_spatial_all %>% filter(inventory_id == inv_id)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Status, shape = species_name)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Alive" = "#4daf4a",      # Green
        "Ingrowth" = "#377eb8",   # Blue
        "Harvested" = "#ff7f00",  # Orange
        "Dead" = "#e41a1c"        # Red
      ), 
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      breaks = c("Pinus halepensis", "Pinus pinea", "Cupressus sempervirens", "Quercus faginea", "Quercus ilex"),
      values = c(
        "Pinus halepensis" = 16,
        "Pinus pinea" = 17,
        "Cupressus sempervirens" = 18,
        "Quercus faginea" = 15,
        "Quercus ilex" = 3
      ),
      labels = c(
        expression(italic("P. halepensis")),
        expression(italic("P. pinea")),
        expression(italic("C. sempervirens")),
        expression(italic("Q. faginea")),
        expression(italic("Q. ilex"))
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black", size = 3))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      color = "Status: ",
      shape = "Species: "
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5)
    )
}

# Create individual plots
p1_v1 <- create_inv_plot_v1(1, "Inventory 1 (2008)")
p2_v1 <- create_inv_plot_v1(2, "Inventory 2 (2014)")
p3_v1 <- create_inv_plot_v1(3, "Inventory 3 (2023)")

# Extract complete legend from p2 (contains all statuses)
legend_grob_v1 <- get_legend(p2_v1 + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal"))

# Combine plots with legend
plots_v1 <- ggarrange(p1_v1, p2_v1, p3_v1, nrow = 3, ncol = 1, legend = "none")
combined_map_v1 <- ggarrange(plots_v1, legend_grob_v1, nrow = 2, heights = c(1, 0.1))

print(combined_map_v1)

# Save high-resolution publication figure
ggsave(filename = "figure_2_tree_spatial_distribution_status.png", plot = combined_map_v1, dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 10)

# Clean memory
rm(p1_v1, p2_v1, p3_v1, legend_grob_v1, plots_v1, create_inv_plot_v1, trees_inv_path)
```

## 3. Tree Spatial Distribution (Color: Species, Shape: Status)

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Reusable plot function (Version 2: Color = Species, Shape = Status)
create_inv_plot_v2 <- function(inv_id, title) {
  df <- trees_spatial_all %>% filter(inventory_id == inv_id)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = species_name, shape = Status)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = c("Pinus halepensis", "Pinus pinea", "Cupressus sempervirens", "Quercus faginea", "Quercus ilex"),
      values = c(
        "Pinus halepensis" = "#1b9e77",
        "Pinus pinea" = "#d95f02",
        "Cupressus sempervirens" = "#7570b3",
        "Quercus faginea" = "#e7298a",
        "Quercus ilex" = "#66a61e"
      ),
      labels = c(
        expression(italic("P. halepensis")),
        expression(italic("P. pinea")),
        expression(italic("C. sempervirens")),
        expression(italic("Q. faginea")),
        expression(italic("Q. ilex"))
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Alive" = 16,       # Solid circle
        "Ingrowth" = 1,     # Empty circle
        "Harvested" = 4,    # Cross 'x'
        "Dead" = 8          # Asterisk
      ), 
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black", size = 3))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      color = "Species: ",
      shape = "Status: "
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5)
    )
}

# Create individual plots
p1_v2 <- create_inv_plot_v2(1, "Inventory 1 (2008)")
p2_v2 <- create_inv_plot_v2(2, "Inventory 2 (2014)")
p3_v2 <- create_inv_plot_v2(3, "Inventory 3 (2023)")

# Extract complete legend from p2 (contains all statuses)
legend_grob_v2 <- get_legend(p2_v2 + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal"))

# Combine plots with legend
plots_v2 <- ggarrange(p1_v2, p2_v2, p3_v2, nrow = 3, ncol = 1, legend = "none")
combined_map_v2 <- ggarrange(plots_v2, legend_grob_v2, nrow = 2, heights = c(1, 0.1))

print(combined_map_v2)

# Save high-resolution publication figure
ggsave(filename = "figure_3_tree_spatial_distribution_species.png", plot = combined_map_v2, dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 10)

# Clean memory
rm(trees_inv, trees_spatial_all, p1_v2, p2_v2, p3_v2, legend_grob_v2, plots_v2, create_inv_plot_v2)
```

## 4. Study Site Location Map (Europe, Spain, and Stand scale)

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# 1. Site Coordinates (Ampudia, Palencia, Spain)
site_coords_utm <- data.frame(x = 353050, y = 4636120)
site_sf_utm <- st_as_sf(site_coords_utm, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 25830)
site_sf_wgs84 <- st_transform(site_sf_utm, crs = 4326)

# 2. Map A: European Context
world_map <- map_data("world")
map_europe <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), 
               fill = "gray92", color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = subset(world_map, region == "Spain"), 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), 
               fill = "gray80", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = site_sf_wgs84, color = "red", size = 2.5, shape = 19) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-12, 28), ylim = c(34, 60), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "a) European context") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA)
  )

# 3. Map B: Spanish Context
auton_path <- ifelse(
  file.exists("layers/ll_autonomicas_inspire_peninbal_etrs89.shp"),
  "layers/ll_autonomicas_inspire_peninbal_etrs89.shp",
  "../../tmp_files/location_map/layers/ll_autonomicas_inspire_peninbal_etrs89.shp"
)

if (file.exists(auton_path)) {
  spain_sf <- st_read(auton_path, quiet = TRUE)
  map_spain <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = spain_sf, fill = "gray95", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = site_sf_utm, color = "red", size = 3, shape = 19) +
    geom_sf_text(data = site_sf_utm, label = " Ampudia (Palencia)", 
                 hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "b) Spanish context") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA)
    )
} else {
  map_spain <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = subset(world_map, region %in% c("Spain", "Portugal")), 
                 aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), 
                 fill = "gray95", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = site_sf_wgs84, color = "red", size = 3, shape = 19) +
    geom_sf_text(data = site_sf_wgs84, label = " Ampudia (Palencia)", 
                 hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-10, 4.5), ylim = c(35.5, 44), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "b) Spanish context") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA)
    )
}

# 4. Map C: Stand Plots Distribution ("En la masa")
plots_shp_path <- ifelse(
  file.exists("plots_limits/parcelas_Ampudia_etrs89_30n.shp"),
  "plots_limits/parcelas_Ampudia_etrs89_30n.shp",
  "final/graphs/plots_limits/parcelas_Ampudia_etrs89_30n.shp"
)

if (file.exists(plots_shp_path)) {
  plots_sf <- st_read(plots_shp_path, quiet = TRUE)
  
  # Assign clear thinning intensity labels with ordered levels
  plots_sf$thinning <- c("Plot 1 (0% Control)", "Plot 4 (45% Thinning)", "Plot 2 (15% Thinning)", "Plot 3 (30% Thinning)")
  plots_sf$thinning <- factor(
    plots_sf$thinning,
    levels = c("Plot 1 (0% Control)", "Plot 2 (15% Thinning)", "Plot 3 (30% Thinning)", "Plot 4 (45% Thinning)")
  )
  
  map_stand <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = plots_sf, aes(fill = thinning), alpha = 0.4, color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_sf_text(data = plots_sf, aes(label = thinning), fontface = "bold", size = 3.2, vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd", name = "Treatment") +
    labs(
      title = "c) Experimental plots distribution (ETRS89 / UTM 30N)",
      x = "UTM X (m)",
      y = "UTM Y (m)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA)
    )
}

# 5. Assemble multi-scale location figure
left_panel <- ggarrange(map_europe, map_spain, nrow = 2, ncol = 1)
location_map_full <- ggarrange(left_panel, map_stand, ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1.3))

print(location_map_full)

# Save high-resolution publication figure
ggsave(filename = "figure_4_study_site_location_map.png", plot = location_map_full, dpi = 300, width = 11, height = 7)

# Clean memory
rm(site_coords_utm, site_sf_utm, site_sf_wgs84, world_map, map_europe, map_spain, map_stand, left_panel, auton_path, plots_shp_path)
if (exists("spain_sf")) rm(spain_sf)
if (exists("plots_sf")) rm(plots_sf)
```
